newsitem.title: USA: GTE Corp sees continued double-digit growth.
newsitem.headline: GTE Corp sees continued double-digit growth.

text.p: STAMFORD, Conn., Jan 28 (Reuter) GTE Corp said on Tuesday it expected continued double-digit growth in 1997, after seeing operating earnings per share grow 11 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 from the same period last year.
For the full year of 1996, GTE's domestic access lines were up by 1.5 million, or 8 percent, while domestic cellular phone users were up 25 percent, to 3.75 million.
Network services revenues from the company's consolidated Canadian and Latin American operations were up 7 percent, passing the $2 billion mark.
GTE Chairman Charles Lee said the company took advantage of the 1996 Telecommunications Act to move into domestic long-distance services, adding 825,000 customers in nine months.

"These strategic actions, along with the strong revenue growth and productivity improvements in our core businesses, are positioning us for the future and driving double-digit earnings growth," Lee said in a statement issued by the company.
